Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-polish-medium-0013", "row_sha256": "3efc3a20086dfce037dfd6df0f3040c4bcae0af0688962d2bcb87e014b0b3673", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {"profile": "Plain and direct."}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "we're doing the ventilation check in the repair workshop before the afternoon shift starts on thursday, and i need a clear note for whoever is covering it because the steps got mixed up last time. please check the two exhaust fans for the sanding area and the intake grille by the side door, and write down the airflow reading from each fan on the inspection sheet. the minimum acceptable reading is the number printed on the sheet, so use that number, not a guess based on how strong the air feels. this check is for those fans and that grille, not a general review of the workshop.

if both fans are running and each reading meets or is higher than the printed minimum, leave the sanding area available for the shift and mark the check complete. if either fan is not running, or either reading is below the minimum, don't mark the check complete and keep the sanding area closed; tell the shift supervisor which fan or reading missed the condition. that second case doesn't mean closing the whole workshop, only the sanding area. please make that distinction clear in the note, and don't say maintenance has fixed anything, since this is only a check and what to do based on its results.", "output": "We’re doing the ventilation check in the repair workshop before the afternoon shift starts on Thursday. Please write clear instructions for whoever is covering the check, since the steps were mixed up last time.

Check the two exhaust fans for the sanding area and the intake grille by the side door. Record the airflow reading from each fan on the inspection sheet. Use the minimum acceptable reading printed on the sheet, not a guess based on how strong the air feels. This check is for those fans and that grille, not a general review of the workshop.

If both fans are running and each reading meets or exceeds the printed minimum, leave the sanding area available for the shift and mark the check complete. If either fan is not running or either reading is below the minimum, do not mark the check complete. Keep the sanding area closed and tell the shift supervisor which fan or reading did not meet the condition. This does not mean closing the whole workshop, only the sanding area. Make that distinction clear in the note. Do not say that maintenance has fixed anything; this is only a check and instructions for what to do based on its results."}]
